supporting_observations.summary: Purified peptide retained antimicrobial activity under multiple heat and pH treatments and after several protease treatments, with loss after Streptomyces griseus protease.
supporting_observations.curation_note: Recorded as qualitative stability context, not converted into organism-specific MIC/toxicity rows.

evidence_absences.finding: Local primary article and supplement do not report hemolysis, cytotoxicity, or cell-viability assay values for subtilomycin; DRAMP says hemolysis information was not found and cytotoxicity was not included.
evidence_absences.impact: No toxicity rows were fabricated; antimicrobial activity rows remain publication-grade with this explicit absence.
